keyPhrases.text: We've come to expect excellence from McDonald
one of the most skilled performers of her generation
navigates those depths steadily and beautifully
Very nearly matching her stride for stride
helps conceal the shortcomings of a sometimes ungainly play
impact of Tyrone's climactic revelation...is somewhat diminished

reasoning: Strong praise for McDonald's 'masterful' and 'transfixing' performance dominates the review, with enthusiastic recognition of both leads' excellence. Minor criticisms of the play itself ('ungainly,' 'diminished impact') prevent this from reaching rave territory, placing it solidly in positive recommendation range.
